property_summary: For all callers and callee behaviors, calling forward(...) on the reference C never reverts purely because msg.sender is not the deployer (owner) — i.e., forward is callable by any address and only reverts if the low-level callee call fails; the mutant adds a caller check that causes forward to revert when msg.sender != owner, breaking that universal permissive property for non-owner callers.
change_summary: Insert a revert if the caller is not the owner, causing forward to revert for non-owner callers whereas original allowed anyone.
